metadata.reviewer_item: R3-1 (stratified test-set bootstrap, paired significance tests, multiple-comparison correction, CIs on differences)

uncertainty_sources.split_layer: test-composition uncertainty: N class-stratified bootstrap evaluation partitions from the untouched original test set; train/validation and all learned artifacts remain fixed
uncertainty_sources.decode_seed_layer: LLM decoding stochasticity: config.RANDOM_SEED reseeded per evaluation (rerun_r1_aggregate pattern); averaged out within each split before pairing

metadata.seed_plumbing_note: Methods do not currently expose a seed kwarg on evaluate(); seeds are plumbed via config.RANDOM_SEED + np.random.seed before construction. A seed kwarg is auto-detected and passed through if added later.
metadata.paired_generation_note: When methods are exactly cl_llmops and agent_nov, both arms share each alarm, sampled hypothesis set, and retrieved evidence. Only verification/gating and the resulting action path differ.

statistics.test: paired two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank on split-level means (N pairs), CL-LLMOps minus baseline
statistics.correction: Holm step-down across all dataset x metric x baseline comparisons
statistics.ci: percentile bootstrap 95% CI on the mean paired difference, 10000 resamples, seed 12345
statistics.p_value_floor_note: With N=10 pairs and no ties, the exact two-sided Wilcoxon p-value cannot fall below 2/2^N = 0.0020; Holm-adjusted values inherit this floor.
